parameters.content:
## 🤖 Analyse IA des offres
Compare chaque nouvelle offre à **ton profil** (CV, compétences, préférences) et calcule :
- un **score de compatibilité** 0-100 + un verdict
- points forts, écarts, **compétences manquantes**
- signaux d'alerte, salaire estimé, niveau, télétravail

Les offres au-dessus de ton **seuil d'alerte** (`/seuil 75`) t'arrivent sur Telegram avec des boutons d'action.

🔒 Les offres sont « réservées » (`FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`) : deux exécutions en parallèle n'analysent jamais la même offre.

parameters.query:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id FROM jobs
  WHERE CASE
    WHEN $1::int IS NOT NULL THEN id = $1::int
    ELSE scored_at IS NULL
         AND score_attempts < 3
         AND (scoring_started_at IS NULL OR scoring_started_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')
  END
  ORDER BY collected_at DESC
  LIMIT 15
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE jobs j
SET scoring_started_at = now(), score_attempts = j.score_attempts + 1
FROM picked
WHERE j.id = picked.id
RETURNING j.id, j.title, j.company, j.location, j.contract_type, j.salary,
          j.description, j.url, j.source, ($1::int IS NOT NULL) AS forced;

WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
    job_id int, score int, verdict text, summary text,
    strengths text[], gaps text[], missing_skills text[], key_skills text[], red_flags text[],
    seniority text, remote text, estimated_salary text, error text)
)
UPDATE jobs j SET
  score              = COALESCE(r.score, j.score),
  verdict            = COALESCE(r.verdict, j.verdict),
  summary            = COALESCE(r.summary, j.summary),
  strengths          = COALESCE(r.strengths, j.strengths),
  gaps               = COALESCE(r.gaps, j.gaps),
  missing_skills     = COALESCE(r.missing_skills, j.missing_skills),
  key_skills         = COALESCE(r.key_skills, j.key_skills),
  red_flags          = COALESCE(r.red_flags, j.red_flags),
  seniority          = COALESCE(r.seniority, j.seniority),
  remote             = COALESCE(r.remote, j.remote),
  estimated_salary   = COALESCE(r.estimated_salary, j.estimated_salary),
  scored_at          = CASE WHEN r.error IS NULL THEN now() ELSE j.scored_at END,
  score_error        = r.error,
  scoring_started_at = NULL
FROM r
WHERE j.id = r.job_id
RETURNING j.id, j.title, j.company, j.location, j.contract_type, j.salary, j.estimated_salary,
          j.url, j.score, j.verdict, j.summary, j.strengths, j.gaps, j.missing_skills,
          j.red_flags, j.remote, j.alerted_at, (r.error IS NOT NULL) AS failed, r.error;
